patterns.key_values: marketing feature-grid (3-col x 4-row headline+description cells) — a web/App-Store-style brand sheet, NOT a native macOS pattern; excluded from pattern canon
loosely: single-CTA anatomy (visual lockup + concise headline + one primary action) present at page level — but this is a marketing hero, not an in-app empty state

signature_moves: Total achromatic commitment — zero accent hue on the entire cover (black wordmark, black pill, gray body, grayscale-metal icon); the preview utility withholds colour so the rendered file content owns it. Swiss/International restraint pushed past its own 'one red or blue' convention.
Von-Restorff CTA by fill alone — the single black filled pill is the one value-break in a flat gray-on-white field; action singularity achieved through shape+value, not saturation.
defects: No app UI supplied — the only UI-adjacent asset is a marketing feature-grid with no window; yields no native surface, no lineage, no chrome/selection/material evidence. Primary corpus limitation (not an app fault). Closes with any single real app-window screenshot.

Icon is achromatic-metallic on a Big-Sur squircle, not Liquid Glass / Icon Composer — reads slightly dated vs current-era layered-glass icons; internally consistent with the monochrome brand, so signature/defect boundary.
Feature-count load (soft) — 12 feature blocks exceed ~5-chunk working-memory span; mitigated by 3-column grouping + F-pattern name-first headings. Fine for a scan surface.
No cross-platform anti-pattern triggered by the composite itself — grid/hierarchy/de-emphasis/action-singularity all clean; the sheet is competent but conventional.

aesthetic.direction: Swiss / International, pushed to pure achromatic (near-white ground, near-black type, hard 3-column grid, no radius on text blocks, single capsule CTA) — the family's lone accent colour deliberately dropped
peers: generic Setapp/App-Store feature-grid marketing sheets (layout template)

psychology: Von Restorff effect — the single black filled pill is the one different element in a flat field, so it is found/remembered; used well (and is the only affordance signal, since there is no colour).
Aesthetic-Usability / processing fluency — the strict monochrome consistency and tight grid maximise fluency, buying a perceived-quality halo on first contact.
Jakob's Law — a conventional feature-grid hero matches trained expectations; low learning cost (also why it is unremarkable as layout).
Hick's Law / capacity — 12 feature chunks is above the ~5-slot comfort span, but this is a scan/browse surface not a decision point, so density is acceptable; column grouping keeps it navigable.
F-pattern scanning + serial position — headings front-load the feature name before its description, and the strongest features sit in the first row; the CTA takes the end position.
notes: CRITICAL for synthesis: this app supplied NO native app UI — only a marketing feature-grid cover (no window inside) and an app icon. Do NOT feed any of this into macOS canon, native clusters, or pattern files; lineage/era are unknown because no chrome exists to read. The rubric_score of 11/14 rates the MARKETING COMPOSITE as a web/brand layout (3 checks N/A), not an app surface; native_audit_score 0 means not-applicable, not failed. meta.json markets AppKit tables + a Quick Look extension (suggesting an AppKit-native product) but marketing copy is not design evidence. The one real design finding is the fully achromatic brand direction. Re-digest with an actual app-window screenshot to obtain any native evidence.
